verdict.rationale: The API docs mention batch-managing custom field option values and polling async job status, implying some bulk-processing capability, but there is no evidence of general bulk operations (e.g., bulk-approving multiple expenses, bulk-updating many transactions) across the platform for an AI-native user. missing for 10: evidence of bulk approve/reject workflows, bulk transaction updates via MCP, and independent confirmation that bulk API calls work at scale.
